retired.name: monaco-full-runtime-arm64-macos
retired.reason: The single about-172-MB-unstripped / about-120-MB-stripped arm64 macOS Monaco artifact mixed application modules with every default runtime feature and is not a same-runner measurement. CI tracks per-closure linkage baselines in this file instead. Render, font, and image-codec product slices are outside this gate.
